description: Declared operational states for tools/hull_state_audit.py. Each state is a config-level deviation (airflow edits and/or an occupancy-side protocol) plus the signature the audit must measure under it. Selectors are generic; per-hull overrides live under 'platforms'.

hvac_casualty_main_ahu.description: Main habitability AHU casualty: the largest-volume supply HVAC group is cut to hvac_duty 0 (the shipped HD-sink star pattern — no supply, no return); its rooms keep only passive adjacency/cross paths.

collective_protection.description: Citadel sealed (collective protection): out-of-citadel supply groups go to hvac_duty 0, boundary-crossing ducts and hatches shut, and the run's ducted-path filtration is raised to the citadel's declared NBC grade.

lockdown_general.description: All-hands lockdown: every agent confined to quarters under enforcement from day 0 (no voluntary-compliance draw, no exemptions); mess-class zones closed.

audit_protocols.name: AUDIT: declared all-hands lockdown
audit_protocols.description: Audit-declared confinement order. scenario_calendar trigger never fires reactively; it activates only through the scenario_schedule named below.
